cases.title: Gherkin Given/When/Then structure detection
cases.objective: Verify that Given (precondition), When (test step) and Then (expected result) are detected from Gherkin text, including Background as a precondition.
cases.expected: Complete scenario -> all three flags = 1; scenario with only a When step -> preconditions 0, steps 1, expected result 0; a Background block counts as a precondition.
cases.actual:
Complete: Given=1 When=1 Then=1
When-only: Given=0 When=1 Then=0
Background block: has_preconditions=1

evidence.label: Input (complete)
evidence.value:
Feature: User Login
  Scenario: Successful login with valid credentials
    Given a registered user "alice@example.com" exists with password "Secret123"
    When the user enters email "alice@example.com" and password "Secret123" and clicks "Login"
    Then the system returns status code 200 and redirects to the "Dashboard" page
  Scenario: Login rejected with wrong password
    Given a registered user "alice@example.com" exists with password "Secret123"
    When the user enters email "alice@example.com" and password "Wrong999" and clicks "Login"
    Then the system displays the error "Invalid email or password"

evidence.label: Input (When-only)
evidence.value:
Feature: Login
  Scenario: login works
    When some action is performed properly on the login

cases.title: Completeness score calculation
cases.objective: Verify completeness = 25 x (Given + When + Then present) + 25 x min(scenarios, 3)/3.
cases.expected: Two-scenario complete feature -> 75 + 16.7 = 91.7; one-scenario When-only feature -> 25 + 8.3 = 33.3.

cases.title: Requirement-coverage metric against acceptance criteria
cases.objective: Verify requirement_coverage measures how much of the linked acceptance-criteria vocabulary appears in the test, and is 0 when no criteria are linked.
cases.expected: Login test vs login ACs -> high coverage (>60); same test with no ACs -> 0; unrelated checkout test vs login ACs -> low (<40).
cases.actual: Login test vs login ACs: 78.9; no ACs: 0.0; checkout test vs login ACs: 31.6

evidence.label: Acceptance criteria
evidence.value:
[
  "The user can login with a valid email and password",
  "If the password is wrong, the system displays an invalid email or password error"
]

cases.title: Specificity score (concrete values in steps)
cases.objective: Verify specificity = % of Given/When/Then/And/But steps containing a quoted literal or a number.
cases.expected: All steps of the login test use quoted values -> 100; vague step -> 0; 1 of 2 steps specific -> 50.
cases.actual: Specific test: 100.0; vague test: 0.0; half-specific test: 50.0

cases.title: Ambiguity score (vague wording)
cases.objective: Verify ambiguity counts vague words (e.g. some, properly, appropriate) per 100 words, scaled and capped at 100.
cases.expected: Precise login test -> 0; 'When some action is performed properly' -> 100 (capped).
cases.actual: Precise test ambiguity: 0.0; vague test ambiguity: 100.0

cases.title: Weighted quality-score formula
cases.objective: Verify the 0-100 quality score equals the documented weighted formula and that the weights sum to 1.
cases.actual: Manual formula = 94.12; compute_quality_score = 94.12; sum of weights = 1.00

cases.title: High / Medium / Low classification thresholds
cases.objective: Verify score-to-label bands: High >= 80, Medium 60-79.99, Low < 60.

cases.title: Well-designed test case classified High
cases.objective: Verify the full pipeline (feature extraction -> formula -> Random Forest) rates a complete, specific, requirement-linked test case as High.
cases.expected: Formula label High, Random Forest label High, method = random_forest.

cases.title: Deficient test case classified Low
cases.objective: Verify a vague, incomplete test case with no linked requirement is rated Low by both the formula and the model.
cases.expected: Formula label Low, Random Forest label Low.

cases.title: PASS/FAIL is not part of the quality-label formula
cases.objective: Verify execution outcome (test_result) has no effect on the quality score / label that defines the training labels.
cases.expected: Score and formula label identical for test_result = 0 (failed), 0.5 (pending), 1 (passed); test_result is not a formula weight.

cases.title: Training labels derive from the formula, not from PASS/FAIL
cases.objective: Verify every row of the training dataset is labelled by the weighted formula over its own features, and that test_result is only weakly correlated with the label.
cases.expected: 100% of rows: quality_label == formula label; |corr(test_result, label)| < 0.2.

cases.title: Model prediction is robust to PASS/FAIL changes
cases.objective: Verify the trained Random Forest does not use execution outcome as a shortcut: flipping only test_result should almost never change its prediction.
cases.expected: Predicted label unchanged when test_result is flipped (0<->1) for >= 95% of dataset rows.
cases.actual: Prediction unchanged for 99.8% of 1000 rows after flipping test_result

cases.title: Reported held-out accuracy is reproducible
cases.objective: Re-create the stratified 80/20 split (random_state=42) used in training and re-evaluate the saved model, confirming the accuracy shown in the UI is genuine.
cases.expected: Re-computed held-out accuracy equals the stored metadata accuracy and is >= 0.85 (proposal target).
cases.actual: Re-computed accuracy 0.9800 on 200 held-out rows; stored metadata accuracy 0.9800

cases.title: Formula fallback when no trained model is present
cases.objective: Verify the service still scores test cases (method = weighted_formula) if the model file is unavailable.
cases.expected: predicted_label == formula_label, empty probabilities, method = weighted_formula.

cases.title: Empty / non-Gherkin description handled safely
cases.objective: Verify a test case with an empty or free-text description does not crash feature extraction and is rated Low.
cases.expected: No exception; all structure flags 0; label Low.
